description.value: The Corner Hotpot is a hotpot restaurant located on West Broadway in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood. Hotpot dining is a communal, interactive style of meal where diners cook ingredients in a simmering broth at the table — a warm and filling stop for a hungry cyclist. The West Broadway corridor offers a dense strip of food and services along a common cycling route connecting central Vancouver to the western suburbs.
